title: John Bible Quiz - Chapter 10
description: Ten questions on John 10: the sheep fold, the good shepherd who lays down his life, and the words at the Feast of the Dedication.

questions.text: What does Jesus call the one who does not enter the sheep fold by the door?
questions.explanation: He says that whoever does not enter by the door but climbs up some other way is a thief and a robber.

questions.text: Why do the sheep follow the shepherd when he brings them out?
questions.explanation: He goes before them and the sheep follow him, because they know his voice.

answers.text: Because he drives them from behind

questions.text: What does Jesus say the sheep will do with a stranger?
questions.explanation: They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him, for they do not know the voice of strangers.

answers.text: They stay still in the fold

questions.text: Why does Jesus say he came, in contrast to the thief?
questions.explanation: The thief only comes to steal, kill and destroy, but Jesus came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

answers.text: So that they may have life abundantly

questions.text: What does the good shepherd do for the sheep?
questions.explanation: Jesus says that he is the good shepherd, and that the good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

answers.text: He lays down his life for them
He hires a servant for them
He builds them a new fold

questions.text: Why does the hired hand leave the sheep when he sees the wolf coming?
questions.explanation: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand and does not care for the sheep.

answers.text: The sheep do not know his voice
He does not care for the sheep

questions.text: What does Jesus say about his other sheep, which are not of this fold?
questions.explanation: He says he must bring them also, that they will hear his voice, and that they will become one flock with one shepherd.

answers.text: They will remain in another fold
They will become one flock with one shepherd
They will be left to the hired hand

questions.text: Where was Jesus walking at the Feast of the Dedication?
questions.explanation: It was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon's porch.

answers.text: In a garden across the brook
In Solomon's porch in the temple

questions.text: For what reason did the Jews say they were stoning him?
questions.explanation: They answered that they were not stoning him for a good work, but for blasphemy, because he, being a man, made himself God.

questions.text: Where did Jesus go after they sought again to seize him?
questions.explanation: He went away beyond the Jordan, into the place where John was baptizing at first, and he stayed there.

answers.text: Beyond the Jordan, where John baptized
To Bethany, the village near Jerusalem
Into the temple treasury in Jerusalem
Up to the Mount of Olives
